title: AutoNumerics: Autonomous Numerical Solver Construction for Partial Differential Equations via Multi-Agent LLM Reasoning

defines.name: AutoNumerics
defines.definition: A multi-agent framework that autonomously designs, implements, debugs, and verifies transparent numerical solvers for general PDEs from natural language descriptions.

problem: Designing accurate numerical solvers for new PDEs typically requires substantial expertise, manual tuning, and lacks accessible automated debugging and verification.
